speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
text: Mr Christopher de Souza, Ms Jessica Tan and I became Members of Parliament in 2006, together in this House.

speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
text: I have grown together with them in my political career, and can say that they are both highly experienced Parliamentarians, model professionals and have a strong sense of fairness and objectivity in them, which make them suited for this role.

speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
text: Mr Christopher de Souza is an accomplished lawyer who has also contributed actively to Parliamentary work.

speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
text: Ms Jessica Tan, comes with extensive corporate experience in senior leadership roles with multi-national firms.
